sources.locator: "Fourth Battle of Gao", revision 1370619931, § February 20–22 attack

explanation: The fourth battle's article opens its account by naming the third and the relation between them: "Ten days after the Third Battle of Gao, the Jihadists launched another offensive to retake the city on 20 February 2013." Both leads say the same thing from either side — the third was "a raid on the city" whose "raiders were defeated", the fourth "an attempt by rebel MOJWA forces to retake the city" — so the sentence is stating a second attempt by the same force at the same objective and not only a date. Probable: Wikipedia alone.
